note: This registry is a product-defined audit contract. It is not an external standard and does not by itself prove website quality.

metrics.test_method: Fetch canonical public URL and record status/final URL.
metrics.limitation: Reachability does not prove indexation or search demand.

metrics.test_method: Fetch robots.txt and sitemap locations when public.
metrics.limitation: Presence does not prove complete crawl coverage or indexation.

metrics.test_method: Inspect index directives, canonical tags and redirect behavior on sampled templates.
metrics.limitation: Sampled directives do not prove full-domain index state.

metrics.test_method: Run dated brand query and record visible result/snippet evidence.
metrics.limitation: One query snapshot does not prove stable visibility share.

metrics.test_method: Run at least three dated non-brand intent queries relevant to visible offer/market.
metrics.limitation: Sampled queries do not prove complete keyword coverage or business performance.

metrics.test_method: Inspect sampled titles, descriptions, H1/H2 structure and intent alignment.
metrics.limitation: Sample quality does not prove rankings.

metrics.test_method: Inspect public structured data for syntax, entity fit and visible-content consistency.
metrics.limitation: Markup presence does not guarantee rich results.

metrics.test_method: Inspect navigation depth, contextual links, descriptive anchors, breadcrumbs and orphan-risk patterns in bounded sample.
metrics.limitation: Bounded crawl does not prove complete link graph.

metrics.test_method: Inspect sampled image alt text, context, filenames and responsive image delivery.
metrics.limitation: Sample does not prove image-search performance.

metrics.test_method: Inspect applicable local entity and language-alternate signals.
metrics.limitation: Signals do not prove local rankings or international targeting success.

metrics.test_method: Use current public/user-authorized real-user field metrics for URL/origin when available.
metrics.limitation: Field sample does not prove every visit or business outcome.

metrics.test_method: Run controlled mobile lab measurement and retain tool/date/config.
metrics.limitation: Lab result is not real-user field performance.

metrics.test_method: Run controlled desktop lab measurement and retain tool/date/config.
metrics.limitation: Lab result is not real-user field performance.

metrics.test_method: Measure sampled transfer/resource weight and identify dominant resource classes.
metrics.limitation: Asset weight alone does not prove user-perceived speed.

metrics.test_method: Inspect formats, responsive images, lazy loading and media delivery on sampled templates.
metrics.limitation: Observed media pipeline does not prove field performance.

metrics.test_method: Inspect public caching/compression headers or reproducible response behavior.
metrics.limitation: Headers alone do not prove end-to-end caching effectiveness.

metrics.test_method: Inspect sampled blocking CSS/JS/resource dependencies with available lab or page tooling.
metrics.limitation: Static inspection does not prove exact blocking time.

metrics.test_method: Inspect responsive rendering and delivery on representative mobile/desktop viewports.
metrics.limitation: Viewport sample does not cover every device.

metrics.test_method: Record observable delivery/CMS/framework hints without asserting private architecture.
metrics.limitation: Public hints do not prove repository, backend or deployment quality.

metrics.test_method: Inspect whether first screen states entity/offer/audience/value clearly.
metrics.limitation: Heuristic clarity does not measure conversion.

metrics.test_method: Inspect prominence and clarity of the primary next action.
metrics.limitation: CTA clarity does not measure conversion uplift.

metrics.test_method: Inspect labels, navigation paths, orientation and information scent.
metrics.limitation: Sampled navigation does not prove task success for all users.

metrics.test_method: Inspect mobile text hierarchy, spacing, tap targets and content order in sample viewport.
metrics.limitation: Viewport review is not full device testing.

metrics.test_method: Inspect public contact/form path for field burden, clarity and visible friction without submitting.
metrics.limitation: Form-surface review does not measure completion rate.

metrics.test_method: Inspect trust cues located near decision/contact moments.
metrics.limitation: Visible proof cues do not establish claim truth.

metrics.test_method: Inspect visual/content hierarchy and scanability on representative templates.
metrics.limitation: Heuristic hierarchy does not replace user testing.

metrics.test_method: Inspect visible validation/error/feedback states only when safely observable without submission.
metrics.limitation: Untriggered states may remain not assessed.

metrics.test_method: Keyboard-sample navigation and visible focus on representative interactive elements.
metrics.limitation: Sample does not establish WCAG conformance.

metrics.test_method: Inspect landmarks, headings, labels and semantic structure in sampled HTML.
metrics.limitation: Sample does not establish WCAG conformance.

metrics.test_method: Inspect representative informative/decorative image alternatives.
metrics.limitation: Sample does not establish complete alternative-text quality.

metrics.test_method: Measure or inspect representative text/background contrast with a reproducible method.
metrics.limitation: Sample does not establish full WCAG conformance.

metrics.test_method: Inspect public form labels/names/instructions without submission.
metrics.limitation: Sample does not establish complete accessible form behavior.

metrics.test_method: Run automated accessibility snapshot and retain tool/version/page scope.
metrics.limitation: Automation alone does not establish WCAG conformance.

metrics.test_method: Check visible imprint/legal surface presence and accessibility.
metrics.limitation: Presence does not establish legal compliance.

metrics.test_method: Inspect visible privacy/consent surface and consistency with observed public behavior where possible.
metrics.limitation: Surface review is not legal advice or compliance proof.

metrics.test_method: Check HTTPS and selected public security headers without active exploitation.
metrics.limitation: Header presence/absence does not prove security posture.

metrics.test_method: Compare entity, contact, service and location facts across sampled public surfaces.
metrics.limitation: Consistency does not prove factual accuracy beyond public evidence.

metrics.test_method: Inspect visible dates, team/service/project recency and stale references.
metrics.limitation: Visible freshness does not prove operational freshness.

metrics.test_method: Inspect references, testimonials, credentials, cases and proof-to-claim proximity.
metrics.limitation: Presence of proof points does not independently verify every claim.

metrics.test_method: Inspect public contact identity, channels and location transparency.
metrics.limitation: Transparency does not prove responsiveness or service quality.

metrics.test_method: Inspect user-authorized analytics/search measurement readiness or public tag evidence only within permission.
metrics.limitation: Tag presence does not prove data quality or business attribution.

metrics.test_method: Check whether the entity can be explicitly identified from visible content and structured data.
metrics.limitation: Extractability does not prove AI citation.

metrics.test_method: Check explicit service, audience, location and applicability statements.
metrics.limitation: Clarity does not prove AI visibility.

metrics.test_method: Check direct answer sections, FAQs and question-to-answer structure.
metrics.limitation: Answerability does not prove chatbot inclusion.

metrics.test_method: Inspect summaries, schema and machine-readable organization of key facts.
metrics.limitation: Structure does not guarantee AI or search presentation.

metrics.test_method: Inspect whether material claims are near attributable proof/cases/references.
metrics.limitation: Visible evidence mapping does not certify claim truth.

metrics.test_method: Compare key entity/service/location facts across sampled pages and structured surfaces.
metrics.limitation: Sampled consistency does not prove whole-site consistency.

metrics.test_method: Inspect topical depth and coverage of likely user questions across sampled content.
metrics.limitation: Depth does not prove topical authority or AI visibility.
